text: Recognize what must still be approved or proven.

Multiplayer launch still needs reuse rights, a reviewed deck and authorized hosting. It also needs security, learning, language, accessibility and operational evidence. Service restoration must be tested. Selecting a hosting technology does not grant approval. Exercises should be presented as workshop abstractions rather than operational platform predictions.

items: A release review would need evidence that multiple teams can obtain viable builds, alongside security, workshop, language and recovery checks.

text: Keep every unmet release condition visible until the proper evidence and approval exist.
Passing calculations cannot replace rights, privacy, hosting, or workshop acceptance.
